# RFC 2579 section 3.1 gives DISPLAY-HINT two grammars: an octet-string
# hint, which is a run of "<count><format>" specifications with optional
# separators, and an integer hint, which is a single base letter with an
# optional "-<places>" for an implied decimal point.
#
# What a textual convention buys is exactly the split RFC 2579 section 3
# describes: the convention's name says what a value means and the base
# type says how it is encoded. TimeStamp and TimeTicks below are the pair
# that makes the split load-bearing — same encoding, different meaning —
# so a resolved object has to carry both.

dialect TEST-TC-MIB SMIv2

type-base   TEST-TC-MIB.DisplayString OCTET STRING
type-hint   TEST-TC-MIB.DisplayString 255a
type-sizes  TEST-TC-MIB.DisplayString 0..255
type-status TEST-TC-MIB.DisplayString current

type-base   TEST-TC-MIB.PhysAddress OCTET STRING
type-hint   TEST-TC-MIB.PhysAddress 1x:

# The DateAndTime hint is the case that decides whether a hint reader can
# tell a separator from the octet count of the specification after it:
# the "1a1d" run has no separator between its two specifications.
type-base   TEST-TC-MIB.DateAndTime OCTET STRING
type-hint   TEST-TC-MIB.DateAndTime 2d-1d-1d,1d:1d:1d.1d,1a1d:1d
type-sizes  TEST-TC-MIB.DateAndTime 8..8 11..11

type-base   TEST-TC-MIB.TimeStamp TimeTicks
type-hint   TEST-TC-MIB.TimeStamp (none)

type-base    TEST-TC-MIB.TruthValue INTEGER
type-members TEST-TC-MIB.TruthValue true(1) false(2)

type-base   TEST-TC-MIB.Percent Integer32
type-hint   TEST-TC-MIB.Percent d-2
type-ranges TEST-TC-MIB.Percent 0..10000

type-base  TEST-TC-MIB.ShortString OCTET STRING
type-sizes TEST-TC-MIB.ShortString 0..32

# An object standing on a convention keeps the convention's name and
# reaches its base through it, and takes the hint and the constraint the
# convention wrote rather than restating them.
oid          TEST-TC-MIB.sysDescription 1.3.6.1.4.1.47002.1
syntax-name  TEST-TC-MIB.sysDescription DisplayString
syntax-base  TEST-TC-MIB.sysDescription OCTET STRING
syntax-hint  TEST-TC-MIB.sysDescription 255a
syntax-sizes TEST-TC-MIB.sysDescription 0..255

oid         TEST-TC-MIB.sysAddress 1.3.6.1.4.1.47002.2
syntax-name TEST-TC-MIB.sysAddress PhysAddress
syntax-base TEST-TC-MIB.sysAddress OCTET STRING
syntax-hint TEST-TC-MIB.sysAddress 1x:

oid         TEST-TC-MIB.sysChanged 1.3.6.1.4.1.47002.3
syntax-name TEST-TC-MIB.sysChanged TimeStamp
syntax-base TEST-TC-MIB.sysChanged TimeTicks

oid            TEST-TC-MIB.sysEnabled 1.3.6.1.4.1.47002.4
syntax-name    TEST-TC-MIB.sysEnabled TruthValue
syntax-base    TEST-TC-MIB.sysEnabled INTEGER
syntax-members TEST-TC-MIB.sysEnabled true(1) false(2)

oid           TEST-TC-MIB.sysLoad 1.3.6.1.4.1.47002.5
syntax-name   TEST-TC-MIB.sysLoad Percent
syntax-base   TEST-TC-MIB.sysLoad Integer32
syntax-hint   TEST-TC-MIB.sysLoad d-2
syntax-ranges TEST-TC-MIB.sysLoad 0..10000

oid          TEST-TC-MIB.sysTag 1.3.6.1.4.1.47002.6
syntax-name  TEST-TC-MIB.sysTag ShortString
syntax-base  TEST-TC-MIB.sysTag OCTET STRING
syntax-sizes TEST-TC-MIB.sysTag 0..32
